title: if you only do one tour in BCN, do this one!!!
text: One of the best tours I've ever done! My family and I took the 'Happiness Tour' on our first day in Barcelona, and it was the perfect way to start our trip. Aidan was super entertaining, knowledgeable, and friendly. Without giving too much away, he led us through the city, blending fascinating history about Barcelona with insights into the study of happiness. We finished the tour feeling great on the inside and out!
